description: After a long run of replies that all open with 'Ha', the next reply must open differently. Real chats fail this about half the time.

history.text: morning, train was packed again
Ha, the usual then. did you at least get a seat?
standing the whole way lol
Ha, brutal. coffee after?
yeah two, i'm wired now
Ha, that tracks. what's on today?
meetings back to back until 3
Ha, rough. anything worth looking forward to?
lunch with a friend i haven't seen in ages
Ha, nice, that's a good one. where are you going?
the noodle place by the office
Ha, solid pick. get the spicy one.
already planning to lol
Ha, good. you know what you like.
sat there for twenty minutes before it moved
Ha, painful. were you late?
nope, got in right on time
Ha, lucky. did the meeting start on time too?
ten minutes late because the projector died
Ha, of course it did. who fixed it?
the intern, with a cable from her bag
Ha, hero. she deserves a coffee.
i bought her one, felt right
Ha, good call. did she say anything?
she looked shocked honestly
Ha, probably doesn't happen much.
then lunch ran long, we talked for two hours
Ha, those are the best ones. what did you talk about?
everything, old jobs, her wedding, whatever
Ha, nice. sounds like a proper catch-up.

script.user: also the coffee machine at the office broke again
